thread:
sarah-smith: Heads up — customer `acme-marketing` reporting weird embedding shapes + huge tail latency on /v1/embeddings route. Started ~09:12 UTC, intermittent 500s and some clients receiving vectors of length 1536 when they expect 768.

eli-ng: ugh. do we have an immediate repro? can you paste the SDK call or curl?

chandra-support: customer sent this minimal repro (sanitized):
```
POST /v1/embeddings
Content-Type: application/json
{
  \"model\": \"embedder-xl-1536\",
  \"input\": [\"short text\", \"longer piece of text...\"],
  \"client_id\": \"acme-123\"
}
```
They also said their SDK batcher is on by default and they upgraded to our JS SDK 2.4 last week.

morgan-ml: details from our logs: dynamic-batcher grouped requests across two pinned routes because the incoming request omitted an explicit model header. The batcher uses a batching key that by default includes model name if present — but some SDK calls were missing model in the envelope so the router fell back to model alias and mixed two variants (embedder-base-768 + embedder-xl-1536) into one coalesced batch. That produces two problems: dimension mismatch for downstream client deserialization, and one large request increases generation time for the whole batch -> tail latency spike.

sarah-smith: can we confirm the exact batcher config for that shard? what were coalesce_window_ms / max_batch_size?

eli-ng: shard x17 shows coalesce_window_ms=6ms, max_batch_size=64, dynamic_batching=true, batch_key=(model, route, priority). But because model header was missing the batch_key collapsed to (null, route, priority) for some requests.

morgan-ml: quick mitigation: set max_batch_size=8 for that route and raise coalesce_window_ms to 12ms to avoid super-large mixing while we patch SDK and instruct client. Also we can temporarily enable strict-model-keying so model must be present or requests go to single-request path.

chandra-support: customer asked for an immediate workaround they can apply client-side. suggested: pin model explicitly in SDK call (model: \"embedder-base-768\") OR set the new header X-Redwood-Model: embedder-base-768. They tried pinning and saw correct dims returned but latency still spiky for a period due to queue drain.

eli-ng: logs show several retry attempts from the SDK after 5xx, causing extra load. One reason they hit billing spike is because retries were configured with linear backoff and doubled tokens due to duplicate payloads. We should advise reducing retry aggressiveness and mark those requests as safe-retry=false if client cannot idempotently retry.

morgan-ml: reproduced locally with a small script that simulates mixed-model callers arriving within same coalesce window:
```
# simple repro
for i in {1..100}; do
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
    -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
    -d '{"model": "'$((i%2==0?"embedder-base-768":"embedder-xl-1536"))'", "input": "hello"}' &
done
```
You can see batches that mix model names if the header is missing/empty — downstream handler then errors or returns wrong shape.

sarah-smith: action items:
- chandra: ask customer to pin model in SDK and temporarily reduce SDK retry count to 1.
- eli: roll a route change for acme-prod -> set max_batch_size=8 and strict-model-keying=true for 30m window.
- morgan: add a fast gating check in batcher that drops requests with conflicting embed-dim into separate batches (hotfix).

chandra-support: forwarded mitigation steps to customer and they confirmed pinning fixed dimension mismatch. they still reported a 10% tail latency bump but no 500s after reducing retries. thanks. :party-parrot: 

eli-ng: I've queued the route patch; deploying to canary now. opsbot you good to monitor queue_depth and tail_p95 on shard x17?

opsbot: deploy started — canary -> 3 instances. Will report p95/p99 every 30s.

(30m later)
opsbot: canary looks good. p95 down from 420ms -> 160ms, p99 down from 1.8s -> 420ms on that route. No 500s in last 15m.

sarah-smith: great. morgan, please follow up with a small permanent change in batcher: require model field for embeddings and add a metric for mixed-model-coalesce_count. That will help catch this earlier.

morgan-ml: on it. I'll PR the check + metric and include a migration note for SDK teams.

chandra-support: closing ICM for customer, tagging docs team to add a note in troubleshooting guide about pinning model and retry config.

sarah-smith: thanks team. saved customer from a billing spiral and fixed the dim mismatch.
